  • Global Alignment and SME Representation

You are an experienced leader with a deep understanding of clinical operations and trial delivery.

Associate Director, Structured Finance: S&P Global Ratings

The Team:

When you join S&P Global Ratings, you become part of one of the world’s leading providers of independent credit risk research and benchmarks. Our team is dedicated to producing high-quality fundamental research based on established criteria. You will have the opportunity to engage with senior corporate executives and interact with the global investor community, contributing to the transparency and comparability of financial markets.

  • Perform rigorous analytical work, research, fundamental credit analysis, analysis of financial statements, building of financial models and forecasts, and writing analytical reports on rated insurance companies.

  • Maintain analytical contact with senior management of rated entities, presenting analytical findings to both internal and external constituencies.
What We’re Looking For:

Basic Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience within structured finance, or within a large commercial bank, investment bank, investing institution, or audit company, specifically in the field of credit analysis of structured finance or equivalent experience.
  • Strong analytical skills with a deep understanding of insurance financial statement analysis and accounting principles.
  • Proficiency with figures and the ability to maintain accuracy and be detail-oriented while complying with deadlines.
  • Ability to prepare forecasts based upon reasoned assumptions.
  • Solid communication skills, both verbal and written, with the capacity to expand, learn, and contribute.

At S&P Global Ratings, our analyst-driven credit ratings, research, and sustainable finance opinions provide critical insights that are essential to translating complexity into clarity so market participants can uncover opportunities and make decisions with conviction. By bringing transparency to the market through high-quality independent opinions on creditworthiness, we enable growth across a wide variety of organizations, including businesses, governments, and institutions.

S&P Global Ratings is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Chief Operating Officer (COO) for overseeing the day-to-day administrative and operational functions of the business. Reporting directly to the CEO, the COO ensures the company executes its strategy efficiently, drives operational scalability, and maintains a high-performance culture across all departments.

Key Responsibilities Operational Leadership & Management
  • Oversee Daily Operations: Direct and control all day-to-day activities across critical departments, including Operations, HR, IT, and other core business functions.
  • Process Optimization: Design, implement, and continuously monitor standardized procedures and workflows to maximize efficiency and productivity across the organization.
  • Risk Management: Identify, evaluate, and mitigate key operational risks to ensure compliance, business continuity, and organizational stability.
Strategic Planning & Execution
  • Strategy Implementation: Translate the CEO's long-term vision and strategic goals into clear, actionable operational plans and departmental targets.
  • Performance Monitoring: Establish, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics, reporting performance insights to the CEO and recommending corrective actions.

Financial & Resource Stewardship
  • Budget Oversight: Collaborate with the CFO to manage the company's operating budget, controlling expenses and identifying opportunities to improve cost efficiency and profit margins.

Talent & Culture Development
  • Leadership Mentorship: Mentor and guide department heads and the senior leadership team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous professional development.
  • Culture Champion: Act as a champion for the company's core values, ensuring the internal culture supports high performance and drives overall employee engagement and retention.
Required Skills & Qualifications Experience & Executive Skills
  • Experience: Minimum of 4 + years of progressive leadership experience.
  • Operational Expertise: Proven track record in scaling operations, driving organizational efficiency, and managing complex cross-departmental functions.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to mentor senior management, lead large teams, and foster a culture of accountability and high performance.
  • Process Knowledge: Expert knowledge of process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) and strategic planning frameworks.
Education & Certification
  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field.
  • Relevant Certifications: Certifications in Executive Leadership, Strategic Management, or Process Improvement (e.g., Lean Six Sigma Black Belt) are highly beneficial.
What We Offer
  • Strategic Impact: Opportunity to directly influence and execute the company’s core business strategy alongside the CEO and Board.
  • Executive Leadership: The chance to lead and mentor a high-caliber team across all major operational units.
  • A collaborative team culture focused on innovation and learning.
  • Flexibility (remote)

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief : "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.

  • Integration Project Coordination & Delivery : Lead the planning, implementation, and delivery of integration projects involving external API service providers, hardware devices (such as printers), and internal systems, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.
  • Technical Solution Design & Optimization : Analyze customer and business needs, coordinate with technical teams to implement system connectivity, process optimization, and new feature development, continuously improving the quality and stability of overall integration solutions.
  • Quality & Process Control : Establish and optimize team collaboration, product testing, launch processes, and integration standards; monitor key indicators to ensure high-standard deliverables.
  • Complex Problem Solving & Technical Challenges : Lead the team to analyze and resolve complex technical issues in project integration and device operation, promote targeted technical solutions, and ensure successful client implementation.

  • Team Development & Capability Building : Develop and organize systematic training and growth plans for team members, continuously identify and cultivate talents, and build a high-performing and cohesive team.
  • Industry Trend Insights & Innovation : Stay updated on order-taking solution development in the restaurant / merchant industry, including APIs, hardware, and apps; drive innovation in integration solutions and lead the professional advancement of the team.
Job Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Computer Science, Information Management, E-commerce, or related fields.
  • At least 3 years of experience in technical integration, system implementation, product operations, or related team management, with a preference for experience in large-scale API, hardware, or integrated solution project management.
  • Strong technical solution analysis, design, and optimization abilities; able to systematically solve complex technical and business problems.
  • Familiar with API interfaces, hardware products (such as printers), apps, and various integration methods; deep understanding of overall solutions for the merchant industry is a plus.
  • Outstanding cross-team communication, coordination, and project management skills; able to drive collaboration and achieve project goals.
  • Ability to organize team training and development, nurture talent, and build a high-performing team.
  • Results-oriented, highly resilient, and self-driven, with awareness of process optimization and high-standard quality control.
  • Native-level Portuguese and strong proficiency in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing); able to communicate efficiently in an international and diverse environment. 9.Experience in restaurant / merchant integration projects or industry solution operations is a plus.
Job Highlights
  • Early-Stage Business : Opportunity to participate in early-stage planning, design, and implementation of team and projects, driving core technology and product innovation.

Prazer, somos a Petz: o melhor ecossistema do segmento pet

A Petz tem como propósito criar valor e proporcionar a melhor experiência possível na relação entre o pet e o seu tutor. E, para que isso seja possível, temos como visão sermos reconhecidos mundialmente, até 2025, como o melhor ecossistema do segmento pet.

Com uma estratégia omnicanal e que integra não só os canais físicos e digitais, mas também os segmentos de produtos e serviços, somos uma plataforma de soluções completa para os animais de estimação.

Nossa proposta é oferecer aos nossos clientes uma experiência de compra e atendimento diferenciado em nossas lojas físicas, além de agilidade e conveniência em nossos canais digitais. Sim, queremos estar presentes em todos os momentos da vida dos nossos clientes, tutores e pets.

Contamos, também, com a maior rede de centros de estética do Brasil e, sob a marca Seres , com a mais abrangente rede de centros veterinários do país; além de, por meio do maior programa nacional de adoção de cães e gatos, o Adote Petz , fomentamos a criação da conexão emocional do tutor com o seu novo melhor amigo.

E ainda nem falamos dos produtos da marca Petz , que já são mais de 300 itens disponíveis em todas as nossas lojas, sendo líder de vendas nas 25 categorias de produtos ofertados. Com um faturamento que cresce mais de 40% ao ano, isso mostra o quanto somos fortes, inovadores e entregamos produtos de qualidade aos nossos clientes.

E, aos poucos, esse ecossistema vem se expandindo e se fortalecendo com a chegada de grandes marcas do segmento junto ao grupo Petz, dentre elas: Zee.Dog , Cansei de Ser Gato, Cão Cidadão e Petix. Legal né?

A estratégia de omnicanalidade nos trouxe até aqui, e assim nos tornamos líderes de mercado e também uma empresa que dobra de tamanho a cada dois anos. Mas somos incansáveis e sabemos que há muito a ser feito, para isso, estamos investindo em fortalecer ainda mais o nosso ecossistema de serviços, produtos e contratação de gente melhor que a gente para continuar alcançando voos ainda mais altos e resultados expressivos.

E você, quer fazer parte deste time de pessoas apaixonadas por pets? Trabalhar num ambiente descomplicado e acolhedor, no qual respeitamos uns aos outros? Onde reconhecemos seus esforços e premiamos resultados? E principalmente, encantamos nossos clientes e temos prazer em servir?

Se você respondeu sim para todas essas perguntas, então vem fazer parte do #EcossistemaPetz #SomosPetz.

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Como Gerente de Operações, você será responsável por garantir a excelência e segurança dos processos de Crédito, Cobrança e Fraude pilares essenciais para a integridade e inteligência da nossa operação de crédito. Sua missão é liderar essas áreas de maneira estratégica, assegurando que cada uma delas opere com altos padrões de desempenho e compliance. Trabalhando de forma colaborativa com os times, você atuará para otimizar processos e implementar melhorias contínuas que garantam uma base de crédito sustentável e uma experiência de cliente confiável e segura.

Com uma visão abrangente e integrada, você supervisionará o modelo de crédito, ajustando políticas conforme o perfil de risco e tendências de mercado para manter uma carteira saudável. Em cobrança, seu foco será maximizar a recuperação de crédito de maneira ética e centrada no cliente, enquanto, em fraude, será o guardião da segurança das operações, aplicando tecnologias e práticas de prevenção que protejam o cliente e a empresa.

title: General Manager of Licensing
description:
About DolarApp

At DolarApp, we’re building the future of cross-border payments in Latin America. We’re looking for a General Manager of Licensing to lead our regulatory licensing strategy across multiple markets. This role is critical to ensuring sustainable growth, market expansion, and regulatory trust as we scale.

What you’ll be doing

Regulation lies at the heart of financial innovation: every license we secure opens the door to a new market, a new product, and thousands of new customers. As General Manager of Licensing, you will work closely with the C‑Suite to drive some of the most critical initiatives for the company, being the strategic mind and driving force when it comes to licensing:

  • Define our licensing strategy: help define the right approach to new product and market launches, and define the strategy for securing and maintaining licenses worldwide – to step ahead of regulators, not behind.

  • Get licenses & maintain them: prepare M&A analyses and due diligence, as well as regulatory strategic plans and documentation for licenses applications on payments, e-money, lending, FX, crypto and whatever our growth demands, and will lead all of our licensing obligations, working with data and engineering to prepare analytical reports.

  • Be our regulatory ambassador: Build trusted relationships with regulators. You’ll represent us with clarity and confidence, ensuring our story is consistent across markets.

  • Build a stellar team: you will hire and lead local licenses’ teams – from Compliance Officers to MLROs or CISOs, making sure the people we appoint are the very best and that they deliver the regulators’ expectations.

  • Partner across the business: Work hand-in-hand with country heads, global functional leaders, HR, and product teams to make licensing a business enabler, not a blocker.

What you’ll need

  • 7+ years of experience in a top tier management consulting firm (BCG, Bain, McKinsey), or in a top tier investment bank (bulge bracket) – ideally with deep experience in fintech, payments, and banking

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, able to bond with regulators, compliance teams and product managers to achieve the company’s goals

  • Excellent organisation, being able to find information about all areas of the company

  • Resourceful and pragmatic, with maximum attention to detail and due diligence – you know when to push, when to negotiate, and when to escape.

  • Ability to work well as part of a team, driven, relentless and a proven closer - you don’t take no for an answer.

  • Business fluent in English; and Spanish. Portuguese is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Sign-on stock options bonus, so you become part of the success of the company

  • Discretionary performance bonus (stock options)

  • Latest technology to work with

  • Strong team that will help you improve your skills

Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities land in our turban. You’ll be working on a newsletter and a digital advertising effort that includes planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data, then this is your playground. You will also own our digital advertising efforts, create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. The salary is USD 1,400 a month for 25 hours a week, managed via Upwork. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow – both the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle.

Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Whoop whoop! Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed ) and in the future, with your help, many more...right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You - Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast-moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows USD 1,400 a month 25 hrs a week Managed via Upwork Oh, and hey... if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses . I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me ****** w ith a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ). Vous agirez en tant que point de contact principal pour les clients, représentant l'entreprise dans les interactions commerciales. Gestion des appels d'offres
  • Analyser les appels d'offres et les transformer en exigences techniques.

  • Assumer la responsabilité de la livraison en temps voulu des propositions techniques et commerciales.
Coordination du développement des propositions techniques et commerciales
  • Participer à l'élaboration d'une stratégie efficace pour remporter un appel d'offres.
  • Assurer la validité des estimations techniques en demandant les temps identifiés pour compléter les lots de travail.
  • Déterminer la structure tarifaire des soumissions pour garantir une rentabilité conforme aux bénéfices ciblés.

Négociations

title: Director Structured Finance
description:
Director – Structured Finance (Brazil) Location : São Paulo

About the Role

Fitch Ratings is seeking a Director to join the Structured Finance team in São Paulo. The Brazil SF team covers local‑market transactions primarily structured via FIDCs, debentures, and securitization companies (CRIs and CRAs). As a Director, you will own a portfolio of complex credits, lead and develop analysts, set analytical direction, and represent Fitch externally. You will drive rating assignments and reviews across Asset Backed Securities and Structured Credit, including cash flow modeling, legal review, collateral analysis, committee leadership, and clear communication of credit opinions to issuers and investors.

What We Offer :
  • Broad exposure to Structured Finance across asset classes and structures in Brazil and Latin America.
  • Hands‑on use and development of Fitch criteria, models, tools, and analytical frameworks.
  • Direct engagement with market participants (originators, servicers, arrangers, investors).
  • A collaborative, high‑performing team environment with opportunities to lead impactful research.
Key Responsibilities :
  • Portfolio and Analysis: Take responsibility for a portfolio of complex SF transactions. Ensure timely, high‑quality new ratings and surveillance.
  • Leadership and Execution: Lead, coach, and mentor analysts; set objectives and provide balanced, timely feedback. Supervise work quality and timelines, manage resources across changing priorities, resolve operational hurdles, and lead rating processes and management review meetings.
  • Research and Market Presence: Initiate and lead publishable research (special reports, market commentary). Share expertise across teams, contribute to cross‑functional initiatives, and represent Fitch externally with originators, servicers, arrangers, investors, and at Fitch events.
  • Modeling, Legal, and Compliance: Oversee cash flow modeling and model use. Review and interpret legal documentation to align with criteria and analytical assumptions. Maintain thorough documentation and version control, and ensure adherence to compliance processes.
  • Communication and Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate rating rationales clearly in presale reports, press releases, presentations, and meetings. Facilitate effective communication within and across teams, encourage contributions, manage conflict constructively, and build strong market relationships.
Qualifications :
  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Engineering, Finance, or related field.
  • Significant experience in structured finance / securitization within ratings, banking, asset management, or advisory.
  • Demonstrated leadership of analysts and portfolios; proven ability to mentor, coach, and develop talent.
  • Strong project management skills; able to manage complex, dynamic workloads and deliver on time.
  • Proficiency with cash flow modeling and performance analytics; comfort with criteria and model application.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English, including presenting to senior audiences and drafting publishable research.
  • Ability to read and interpret legal documents and participate effectively in meetings in Portuguese and English.
  • Team‑oriented, with a track record of building effective internal and external relationships; high attention to detail.
Preferred :
  • Line management experience (hiring, performance feedback, development planning).
  • Experience enhancing analytical tools, dashboards, or databases to drive productivity and insight.
  • Exposure to multiple SF asset classes (e.g., trade receivables, auto, SME) and to Latin America markets.
How You’ll Succeed :
  • Deliver consistent, high‑quality analysis and timely outputs across a diverse portfolio.
  • Elevate team capability through coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
  • Lead insightful research that advances Fitch’s market presence.
Why Fitch?

At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone.

Every team member is essential to our business and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority.

We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey.

Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.

Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.

Especialista em Infraestrutura | Cloud & DevOps

A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro, com mais de 27 anos de atuação e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe. Com mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente, somos referência em soluções que impulsionam a transformação digital do mercado. Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software, atendendo instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs que buscam inovação, segurança e eficiência. Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica, a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros, promovendo um ecossistema mais conectado e acessível.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar como Especialista em Infraestrutura | Cloud & DevOps , sendo protagonista na evolução dos nossos ambientes híbridos e multi-cloud, promovendo integração entre times de Desenvolvimento, Segurança e Operações, e contribuindo diretamente para a agilidade das entregas e a transformação tecnológica da empresa.

Esse cargo é responsável por:

  • Instalar, automatizar e gerenciar ambientes híbridos e multi-cloud (On Premises e Cloud).
  • Promover a cultura DevOps, integrando áreas de Desenvolvimento, Segurança da Informação e Operações (Infraestrutura, NOC e Plataformas).
  • Propor soluções técnicas que atendam às demandas do negócio, considerando requisitos de escalabilidade, desempenho e flexibilidade.
  • Atuar na criação e suporte de pipelines de CI / CD, garantindo agilidade nas entregas com alto nível de qualidade.

Para dar match, essa vaga necessita que atenda alguns requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de soluções e ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Domínio de sistemas operacionais Linux / WSL e Windows.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade.
  • Scripting e automação (ex: Bash, Python).
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código (IaC).
  • Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados (SQL e NoSQL).
  • Uso de ferramentas de controle de versão (Git).

Caso possua o conhecimento ou atuação abaixo, será um diferencial:

  • Certificações em Cloud, DevOps ou infraestrutura (ex: AWS Certified, Azure Administrator, CKAD).
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados ou no setor financeiro.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança da informação aplicadas à infraestrutura.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e integração contínua.

IMPORTANTE: Essa oportunidade é para atuação no escritório da Evertec Brasil na Av. Paulista/SP, modalidade híbrida.

title: SUPERVISOR DE CORTE
description:
Para você que se identifica e gosta de moda: a ViX Paula Hermanny está procurando um supervisor de corte que será responsável por realizar o acompanhamento das peças a serem cortadas de acordo com o risco e ordem de corte, controle dos modelos e datas de saída de cada pedido, solicitação material e conferência.

Principais atividades:

  1. Planejamento e Organização do Corte
    • Organizar a programação de corte de acordo com a demanda de produção.
    • Definir os materiais e insumos necessários para cada lote de produção.
    • Planejar a sequência de cortes, levando em consideração a otimização do uso de tecido e o aproveitamento máximo do material disponível.
  2. Gestão de Equipe
    • Supervisionar a equipe de corte, garantindo que todos os colaboradores cumpram os padrões e procedimentos estabelecidos.
    • Treinar novos colaboradores e promover o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe.
    • Realizar a gestão de turnos, escalas e garantir a disciplina e motivação da equipe.
  3. Controle de Qualidade
    • Garantir que os cortes sejam realizados com precisão, seguindo os moldes e especificações do design.
    • Identificar e corrigir problemas de qualidade no corte, como falhas nos moldes ou irregularidades no tecido.
    • Realizar inspeções regulares para verificar a conformidade com as normas de qualidade estabelecidas pela empresa.
  4. Acompanhamento de Produção
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção e verificar se o cronograma de corte está sendo cumprido.
    • Resolver eventuais problemas que possam surgir durante o processo, como falta de material, erro no corte, ou necessidade de ajustes no molde.
    • Realizar a comunicação constante com outros setores, como modelagem, produção e acabamento, para garantir a fluidez do processo.
  5. Gestão de Materiais e Recursos
    • Controlar o estoque de tecidos, garantir o uso adequado dos materiais e evitar desperdícios.
    • Acompanhar a manutenção e conservação das máquinas de corte.
    • Identificar a necessidade de reposição de materiais e insumos e realizar os pedidos de reposição.
  6. Relatórios e Acompanhamento de Resultados
    • Gerar relatórios periódicos sobre a produtividade, desperdícios e eficiência do processo de corte.
    • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e sugerir melhorias para otimização do processo.
    • Garantir que os custos com o processo de corte estejam dentro do orçamento estabelecido.
  7. Segurança e Normas
    • Garantir que os procedimentos de segurança sejam seguidos, minimizando riscos de acidentes durante o processo de corte.
    • Cumprir com as normas ambientais, de saúde e segurança no trabalho, implementando ações de prevenção de acidentes.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  1. Ensino médio completo.
  2. Liderança e capacidade de gerenciamento de equipes;
  3. Conhecimento técnico sobre o processo de corte, tipos de tecidos e materiais.
  4. Habilidade para trabalhar com sistemas de controle de produção e relatórios.
  5. Atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de solucionar problemas rapidamente.
  6. Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com outros departamentos.

title: Co-founder técnico | Samax
description:
A Samax é uma plataforma inovadora de gestão de custos em cloud, focada em ajudar empresas a otimizar seus gastos com infraestrutura tecnológica. Estamos em fase Pré-Seed e buscamos uma pessoa para assumir papéis estratégicos na startup, como co-founder técnico (CTO).

Reconhecemos que a experiência e o conhecimento necessários podem vir de diversas fontes, pois não acreditamos em uma única trajetória para o sucesso empreendedor. A seguir, alguns perfis que, se você possui essas experiências, indicam maior alinhamento com o que buscamos. Cada experiência tem seu próprio nível de relevância e potencial:

  1. Experiência fundadora ou empreendedora prévia: ter (co)fundado uma empresa que, independentemente do sucesso, conseguiu desenvolver um produto, gerar receita e conquistar clientes.
  2. Experiência em desenvolvimento e arquitetura de software: ter liderado times de tecnologia ou desenvolvido produtos escaláveis, preferencialmente em cloud computing e SaaS.
  3. Experiência em startups de alto crescimento: ter atuado em startups durante fases de crescimento acelerado e enfrentado desafios de escalabilidade.
  4. Conhecimento profundo em otimização de custos em cloud: ter expertise em infraestrutura AWS, Google Cloud ou Azure, com foco em eficiência e redução de custos.
  5. Capacidade de liderar equipes técnicas: saber estruturar times, definir processos ágeis e tomar decisões estratégicas sobre tecnologia.
  6. Vivência em Big Techs: ter atuado na área de desenvolvimento de empresas de tecnologia de ponta, acumulando conhecimento e prática em ambientes altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma lista exaustiva de requisitos. Buscamos pessoas movidas por intensa motivação e prontas para enfrentar os desafios da jornada empreendedora . Procuramos não apenas colaboradores, mas parceiros comprometidos com a construção de algo do zero, vivenciando tanto os momentos estratégicos quanto os operacionais, sempre com foco no sucesso da empresa.

Somos uma empresa Talentum . Mas o que isso quer dizer?

Significa que, ao seu lado, você terá um Startup Studio , que atua como um Co-fundador ativo e mão na massa, além de ser o primeiro investidor. Trazemos vantagens competitivas únicas, que empresas nascidas sozinhas não possuem:

  1. Fazemos, junto com você, as primeiras vendas: graças aos nossos 12+ anos na indústria, temos acesso a clientes com quem construímos relacionamentos ao longo dos anos, que não são facilmente acessados sem essa conexão prévia.
  2. Temos playbooks que detalham cada passo da operação de uma empresa nascente.
  3. Acessamos uma rede de mentores experientes: sempre que desafios complexos surgem, contamos com uma rede de mentores da indústria para auxiliar na discussão e orientar na solução de problemas.
  4. Somos os primeiros investidores da empresa: com nossa injeção de capital, apoiamos a operação inicial, permitindo que os fundadores busquem as primeiras fontes de receita enquanto desenvolvem seus produtos mínimos viáveis e suas operações.
  5. Boilerplate de tecnologia: você terá acesso a um boilerplate e a um design system robusto, fornecidos pela Talentum, para acelerar o desenvolvimento dos produtos.

Se você tem o desejo de construir algo grande e transformar a forma como empresas gerenciam seus custos em cloud, queremos conversar com você!

Maria Luiza Raymundo (Malu) - Pessoas, Cultura e Gestão Talentum

title: Pleegzorgbegeleider regio Foodvalley/Eemland
description:
Ben jij er graag voor (pleeg)kinderen, ouder(s) en pleegouders, zodat kinderen kunnen opgroeien in een stabiele en fijne omgeving? Kom dan werken bij Timon. Lees hieronder meer over onze actuele vacature pleegzorgbegeleider in regio Foodvalley en Eemland. De kantoorlocatie is Veenendaal.

Een stabiele en veilige omgeving is niet altijd vanzelfsprekend. Daar weten we bij Timon alles van. Lukt het echt niet thuis, dan is een pleeggezin vaak een oplossing, voor korte of langere tijd. Als pleegzorgbegeleider bij Timon ondersteun je (pleeg)kinderen, ouder(s) en pleegouders bij de uitdagingen waarvoor zij staan. Elke situatie is anders. Het kan gaan om een vrijwillige of gedwongen plaatsing in het eigen netwerk of bij een pleeggezin van Timon.

Jouw werk doet ertoe!

Als pleegzorgbegeleider coördineer je de pleegzorgplaatsing en alles wat daarbij komt kijken. Samen met ouder(s), pleegouders, de verwijzer en eventuele andere (in)formele betrokkenen vorm je een zorgteam. Samen stel je een plan op waarin het belang en de ontwikkeling van het kind centraal staat. Je houdt zicht op wat iedereen nodig heeft en signaleert wanneer de ontwikkeling van het kind in de knel raakt of dreigt vast te lopen. Samen met het zorgteam zoek je naar oplossingen vanuit de visie op gedeeld opvoederschap. Dat vraagt van jou als pleegzorgbegeleider om geduld, sensitiviteit en daadkracht. En, als de situatie erom vraagt, overwicht. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe!

Dit ga je doen
  • Je ondersteunt het (pleeg)kind, de ouder(s) en pleegouders en werkt verbindend
  • Je stelt samen doelen op, legt die vast in een plan en gaat daarmee aan de slag
  • Je bent een klankbord voor ouder(s) en pleegouders en biedt handvatten voor het vormgeven van hun ouderrol op afstand/opvoedrol en rol binnen het zorgteam
  • Je houdt contact met instanties als school, GGZ, Jeugdbescherming en CJG
  • Je zorgt dat iedereen zich gehoord en gezien voelt
  • Je werkt zelfstandig en overlegt met collega’s en de gedragswetenschapper

'Het mooist vind ik wanneer we samen met ouders en pleegouders een kind zien ontwikkelen.'

Nicole van Schaijk, pleegzorgbegeleider bij Timon. Lees het hele verhaal van Nicole.

Dit vragen we van je
  • Een relevant hbo-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek)
  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie
  • Rijbewijs B en een auto
  • Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden
  • Een aantal jaar relevante werkervaring in de jeugd- of pleegzorg
Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg (schaal 9) van €3191,69 tot €4766,96, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring
  • Een jaarcontract voor 24 uur per week. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dit contract om in een vast dienstverband
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris
  • Een eigen coach die jou helpt met je persoonlijke doelstellingen en ontwikkeling

Binnen Timon krijg je een uitgebreid inwerktraject waarin we je koppelen aan een buddy. Daarnaast volg je diverse trainingen en opleidingen gericht op jouw functie, zoals: Functiescholing pleegzorg, Contextuele hulpverlening en Traumasensitief werken.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?

Denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij je past? Solliciteer dan uiterlijk 19 december op de vacature voor pleegzorgbegeleider. Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Lucïenne Prinssen (teammanager), tel. . Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiter Christa Doornenbal, tel. .

Voor indiensttreding is het screeningsbeleid van Timon van toepassing. Deze is altijd opvraagbaar en wordt toegelicht in het arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek.

A Genial Investimentos é uma das maiores plataformas de investimentos do Brasil. Com mais de 2 milhões de clientes, estamos presentes em todo o país por meio de nossos escritórios e assessores parceiros. Nascemos com um propósito claro: democratizar o acesso ao mercado financeiro , oferecendo produtos, serviços e tecnologia de ponta para todos os perfis de investidor — do iniciãço ao profissional.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo que vai de renda fixa, ações, fundos de investimento, previdência e fundos imobiliários , até soluções de serviços bancários digitais , como conta com Pix, cartão de crédito e pagamentos integrados. Também desenvolvemos soluções sob medida para empresas, como Genial As a Service , que oferece infraestrutura bancária via API.

Quer conhecer mais sobre a Genial? Acesse:

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Banking para liderar as verticais de Previdência Aberta (PGBL/VGBL), Consórcio e Seguros no canal B2C. A missão é escalar crescimento (captação, véndas, base ativa e receita), elevando penetreação de produtos, experiência do cliente e governança regulatória.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Definir e executar a estratégia de crescimento das três linhas (go-to-market, metas, segmentos, esteiras e funis);
  • Construir e gerir o funil completo : prospecação → qualificacão → proposta → emissão/adesão → ativação → recorrência/portabilidade → retenção;
  • Previdência : captação líquida, portabilidade de entrada, mix PGBL/VGBL, recorrência, saldo administrado e taxa de cancelamento;
  • Consórcio : adesões, conversão por segmento, inadimplência, engajamento até contemplação e utilização da carta de crédito;
  • Seguros (vida, residência, auto e afinidades): prêmios emitidos, vidas/beneficiários, taxa de renovamento e cross-sell com investimentos;
  • Parcerias com seguradoras e administradoras : negociação de portfólios, condições comerciais, produtos e campanhas co-branded;
  • Orquestrar campanhas multicanais (WhatsApp, e-mail, inbound/outbound), roteiros e playbooks comerciais para assessores;
  • Habilitar o time : trilhas de formação técnica/comercial, rituais de gestão, 1:1, feedbacks e coaching de performance;
  • Gestão por dados : leitura de CRM/BI (ex.: Salesforce/Power BI), previsibilidade de pipeline e planos de ações semanais;
  • Compliance e regulações : aderência a SUSEP/CNSP (seguros e previdência aberta), Bacen (consórcios), LGPD e políticas internas;
  • Integração com Produtos, Marketing, Jurídico/Compliance e Operações para remover "dores", acelerar time-to-market e elevar NPS.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência comprovada em lideração comercial nas linhas de previdência, consórcio e/ou seguros no varejo financeiro (bancos digitais, corretoras, seguradoras, administradoras);
  • Histórico de crescimento com metas agressivas (captação/véndas, base ativa, receita) e gestão de times B2C;
  • Forte visão analítica e dominio de CRM/BI (ex.: Salesforce, Power BI/Looker);
  • Conhecimento dos produtos e regulações : PGBL/VGBL, consórcio, seguros de pessoas/ramo elementar; normas SUSEP/CNSP , Bacen (Lei 11.795/2008 – consórcio) e LGPD ;
  • Graduação completa.

Diferenciais:

  • Habilitação de Corretor(a) de Seguros (SUSEP) ou vivência em corretoras/seguradoras;
  • Certificações CPA-20/CEA (desejáveis), CFP® (diferencial);
  • Experiência com parcerias B2B2C , canais digitais e squads de produto;
  • Noções de SQL/Databricks para exploração de dados e segmentação;
  • Vivência com Open Finance e jornadas digitais de aquisição.

Informações adicionais

Buscamos profissionais que tenham vontade de crescer, colocar a mão na massa e fazer acontecer. Vivemos um momento único, recheado de desafios e oportunidades para agregar ainda mais valor aos nossos clientes. Growth Marketer – Part-Time (Potential for Head of Marketing)

Hi… My name is Lena, founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with words like driven, team player, high performer, I am giving you the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+ %) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services.

Your marketing DNA has to be analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously.

You will also own our digital advertising efforts – planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. You can create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas to reach new runners, companies, and destinations.

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture, and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world. We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and, with your help, many more in the future.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast‑moving, and positive company should.

title: MSF Access Executive Director
description:
Location: Strong preference to be based in one of the five MSF Access Regional Hubs (Rio de Janeiro, Dakar, Brussels, Nairobi, and Kuala Lumpur). Placement in associated strategic locations may be considered.

Duration: MSF office contract, minimum 3 years commitment, extendable by 3 years, according to MSF practice and subject to national labour laws

Deadline to Apply:

Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting to: The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date: Beginning of Q2 2026 preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:

“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION

The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access’s mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Executive Director’s primary responsibilities will include:

Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability

  • Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access

  • Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget

  • Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director

  • Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee

  • Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access

External Representation and Engagement

  • Representation of MSF Access in critical high-level global health and access discussions including in multilateral fora and processes, in government engagements where requested, with private sector leaders and other relevant stakeholders alongside the MSF Access MT

  • Steer MSF Access’s overall external partnership strategy in alignment with the broader MSF Access strategy and cultivate engagement with key global health and access stakeholders

Internal Leadership and Management

  • Management and coordination of key MSF Access functions (as articulated below) alongside the management team

  • Report to the MSF Access Board on key strategic and governance decisions and with informational updates of note, including but not limited to, major decisions relating to the content of MSF’s Access work, any material engagement with MSF leadership and governance structures, management of the MSF Access MT along with the DED, regular budgetary updates and accountabilities, and alongside the Head of Human Resources any HR issues requiring the attention of the board.

  • Alongside the DED and management team, translating the MSF Access Strategic Plan into annual plans for each respective body of work, including through individual projects and initiatives

  • Oversee development of MSF Access administrative policies and processes and addressing critical human resources issues

  • Development and finalization of the MSF Access annual plan and budget alongside relevant members of the management team

  • Representing MSF Access on the Medical Operational (MedOps) platform (which includes all medical directors and directors of operations across MSF) including participation in MedOps meetings as required

The ED is also responsible for ensuring that MSF Access fulfils its articulated responsibilities to the movement, which are:

  • Advise the Movement on the Common Priorities

  • Provide or source support on access issues to all entities that request it within MSF

  • Design and implement access initiatives to respond to the Common Priorities

  • Maintain an overview and report on access initiatives movement-wide on an annual basis

  • Survey and analyze the external access landscape

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of senior management and leadership experience in global health policy, advocacy, institutional management, or humanitarian affairs

  • PhD or Master’s degree in health sciences (medical, (bio)medical, pharmacy) or international relations, public policy, public administration, public health with significant experience working in and knowledge of global health and access issues.

  • Demonstrated experience in global health and access issues in a broad range of subjects relevant to MSF’s medical humanitarian mission and operations.

  • Deep understanding of MSF’s operational and medical nature and its medical humanitarian mission.

  • Advanced managerial capabilities and experience with excellent project management capabilities, multidisciplinary teams and ability to work effectively and independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience in developing and maintaining professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and organizations, including government officials, multilateral representatives, medical professionals, civil society, community organizations, academia, and global health donor organizations.

  • Experience in strategy development processes and demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.

  • Proven track record of external engagements and external representation; ability to actively participate in public speaking engagements, including—but not limited to—presenting at conferences, conducting print and broadcast media interviews, and representation in external meetings.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

Note: All offers of employment will be subject to reference checks and to appropriate screening checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her/their understanding of these recruitment procedures.

Descrição da vaga

Coordenar a área de desenvolvimento de sistemas, garantindo que os processos e pessoas estejam alinhados aos objetivos da empresa, supervisionando a execução das iniciativas, monitorando indicadores de desempenho e promovendo a melhoria contínua nos fluxos de trabalho em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de sistemas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Operacionalizar o cascateamento das estratégias corporativas com seus liderados, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos da organização e atingimento das metas.
  • Definir, acompanhar e analisar indicadores estratégicos e operacionais, promovendo a melhoria contínua dos processos e resultados da área.
  • Gerir o ciclo de vida dos colaboradores, definindo estratégias de atração, integração, capacitação, avaliação de desempenho, motivação e retenção, assegurando que a equipe esteja preparada para atender às necessidades e objetivos da organização.
  • Liderar a equipe sob sua gestão direta, promovendo capacitação técnica e comportamental, para estimular motivação, integração e clareza de responsabilidades.
  • Apoiar as áreas clientes e os líderes de produto na avaliação das necessidades de software, avaliar a viabilidade técnica, a adequação das soluções propostas e a correta alocação de recursos humanos e tecnológicos agregando valor e alinhado à necessidade do negócio.
  • Assegurar, por meio da supervisão dos líderes técnicos e engenharia, que as soluções em desenvolvimento atendam aos requisitos funcionais, de qualidade, estabilidade e usabilidade.
  • Colaborar na definição e execução de planos de contingência, continuidade operacional e recuperação de incidentes críticos, para minimizar impactos e preservar a estabilidade dos serviços.
  • Gerir contratos e relacionamentos com fornecedores de tecnologia, para assegurar cumprimento de prazos, qualidade dos serviços e aderência a requisitos legais e contratuais.
  • Fomentar melhorias em processos, normas e metodologias de desenvolvimento de software, incluindo boas práticas em todo ciclo de desenvolvimento de sistemas.
  • Incentivar e promover a adoção de práticas de gestão ágil, disseminando cultura de colaboração, adaptação, mantendo um fluxo contínuo de entrega e de valor.
  • Fazer uso de metodologias consolidadas de mercado para entender as oportunidades de negócio, promovendo inovação e transformação digital em todos os níveis organizacionais, construindo soluções adequadas através de boas práticas e ferramentas, para gerar eficiência e competitividade.
  • Assegurar comunicação eficaz entre o time de desenvolvimento, áreas de negócio e stakeholders, para traduzir requisitos técnicos em resultados alinhados às expectativas de negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software, coordenação de equipes e projetos de TI, gestão de fornecedores e indicadores, integração de sistemas (APIs, microsserviços e nuvem), metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de gestão, liderança de pessoas e condução de transformações digitais.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de TI, Gestão de Projetos.

Conheça o nosso jeito

Há 30 anos atuando no mercado de transporte, temos consciência do nosso comprometimento em diversas esferas; seja social, ambiental ou econômica. E trabalhamos para transmitir esse entendimento também à nossa equipe, para que ela se desenvolva da melhor maneira possível e que cada colaborador sinta orgulho em levar os valores da Expresso São Miguel além dos nossos portões. Com respeito e seriedade. A Expresso São Miguel conta com mais de 180 unidades, 2800 veículos e 10.000 colaboradores diretos e indiretos .

Toda a estrutura da Expresso São Miguel é dedicada ao transporte de cargas fracionadas, o que faz com que tenhamos a maior presença em todo Sul e Sudeste do País. Mas não somos apenas caminhões, equipamentos ou prêmios, não somos uma mera transportadora, somos pessoas que fazem a diferença, dia após dia, no segmento de prestação de serviços de cargas fracionadas. É o nosso “jeito”! Desde sempre fomos orientados pelo DNA, desde sempre iremos desenvolver ações para preservar a essência de ter processos inovadores de gestão, de operação, de expansão, de desenvolvimento e de crescimento. Desde o início das nossas atividades nos preocupamos com o impacto que os nossos serviços geram para o meio ambiente e para a sociedade.

Isso é ser Expresso São Miguel!

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com – your go‑to for online checkout. We partner with brands like eBay, ASOS, Klarna, UberEats, and Sony to provide frictionless payment experiences. With 19 offices on six continents and a London HQ, we empower merchants to boost acceptance rates, cut costs, fight fraud, and deliver remarkable customer experiences.

Job Description

Global payments are complex and ever‑evolving. At Checkout, our software engineers develop next‑generation payment technologies that enable merchants to boost acceptance rates, cut processing costs, fight fraud, and create cutting‑edge customer experiences. We’re looking for Senior Software Engineers who bring fresh ideas, have a curious nature, and are passionate about working in an engineering environment focused on building products to achieve the company’s strategic goals.

What We’re Looking For
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • Proficiency in C# .NET, Java, or Go with a strong understanding of software development principles in a backend or full‑stack environment
  • Great communication skills and the ability to interact effectively with a wide range of stakeholders
  • Experience working in agile environments and delivering high‑quality code within tight deadlines
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • AI proficiency or curiosity; hungry to embrace the latest technology to enhance productivity
  • Payments or financial knowledge is a plus, but not a necessity
How You’ll Make an Impact
  • Collaborate with product management and cross‑functional teams across a large engineering community
  • Define and design loosely coupled, scalable systems in a microservices architecture using industry best practices
  • Stay up‑to‑date, spread knowledge of the latest technologies used by Checkout
  • Write clean, maintainable, extendable, and testable code on Checkout’s most impactful
  • Build, own, and operate your systems to the highest levels of resilience and service
  • Mentor junior team members and assist in their technical development
Benefits

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive – through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. You’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, back each other to succeed, and back each other to succeed. Our hybrid model offers flexibility with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. If you need anything to make your experience more comfortable, let us know.

title: PROFISSIONAL DE EDUCAÇÃO FISICA - CAPS
description:
Job description

O CAPS é um serviço destinado a acolher e acompanhar pacientes com transtornos mentais graves, através de atendimento integral que visa estimular e apoiar os usuários em suas iniciativas de busca da autonomia, acesso ao trabalho, lazer, exercício dos direitos civis e fortalecimento dos laços familiares e comunitários.

As equipes são compostas de Médico, Psicólogo, Enfermeiro, Assistente Social, Educador Físico, Psicopedagogo e Terapeuta Ocupacional, dentre outros profissionais.

As atividades contam com atendimentos individuais, ações coletivas, oficinas terapêuticas e ações de articulação junto aos demais Serviços de Saúde da rede e de outros setores (Educação, Cultura, Lazer, Esporte, Assistência Social).

Os atendimentos são voltados ao público adulto (CAPS Adulto), pacientes com dependência química (CAPS Álcool e Drogas) e crianças e jovens (CAPS Infanto-juvenil), e não há necessidade de encaminhamento para ser atendido.

Main responsibilities
  • Cumprir rotinas, normas e regulamentações da Instituição e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde;
  • Seguir os protocolos assistenciais estabelecidos para a unidade;
  • Comunicar ao Gestor imediato a ocorrência de não conformidades;
  • Participar, ativamente, das reuniões de equipe;
  • Registrar as ações de produção em planilhas, elaboração de relatórios;
  • Participar de Comissões internas e externas da Unidade;
  • Participar de eventos de formação, atualização e integração da rede, promovidos pela Secretaria Municipal de Saúde e Instituição;
  • Contribuir para a interação da equipe, nos aspectos técnico e relacional;
  • Realizar acolhimento, intervenções institucionais (quando houver necessidade), atendimentos individuais e ou familiares, visitas domiciliares, hospitalares e escolares;
  • Coordenar grupos e oficinas terapêuticas e outros dispositivos grupais, internos ou externos à unidade;
  • Levantar e manter atualizado o perfil do território de inserção da unidade;
  • Propor, promover e participar, ativamente, de reuniões de articulação com a rede, discussões de casos e do processo de trabalho, atendimento compartilhado, ações intersetoriais no território, que contribua no processo de cogestão e corresponsabilização no agenciamento do projeto terapêutico singular da população atendida;
  • Registrar em prontuário todas as informações pertinentes relacionadas à identificação, com data, hora, assinatura e carimbo, e condutas pertinentes a cada intervenção;
  • Acolher e encaminhar os usuários e seus familiares para outros profissionais da unidade ou outros serviços de acordo com a demanda;
  • Prestar atendimento ao usuário em situação de violência, risco e de vulnerabilidade social, notificando os órgãos competentes;
  • Acompanhar o processo de alta e inserção em outro serviço;
  • Fazer contato com os órgãos competentes para providenciar remoções de usuários que necessitem de encaminhamento para outros serviços;
  • Exercer todas as atribuições de acordo com o código de ética da categoria profissional correspondente;
  • Manter regularizada inscrição em Conselho de classe;
  • Realizar avaliação física, através de instrumentos específicos;
  • Trabalhar a prática corporal em todas as instâncias da saúde mental;
  • Orientar, através de métodos específicos, toda a equipe da unidade, profissionais da rede e grupos populacionais quanto aos procedimentos específicos de sua área de atuação;
  • Zelar por todos os equipamentos, materiais e documentos pertinentes da unidade;
  • Realizar provisão, solicitação e zelar pelos bens de consumo e permanentes utilizados nas oficinas e grupos de sua responsabilidade;
  • Acompanhar os usuários em atividades e rotinas diárias na unidade, inclusive na ambiência;
  • Organizar, distribuir e acompanhar as refeições dos usuários;
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD;
  • Realizar as atividades das áreas/setores, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.
Requirements and skills
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Educação Física
  • Atividade física adaptada e saúde, Exercício físico aplicado à reabilitação cardíaca e a grupos especiais, Exercício físico como terapia para demências e doenças psiquiátricas, Fisiologia e cinesiologia da atividade física e saúde, Fisiologia humana aplicada as ciências da saúde, Ginástica laboral, Prescrição de exercícios para obesidade, Emagrecimento e saúde, Saúde Pública,Pratica Integrativas e Complementares em Saúde (PICS) Treinamento funcional ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na área
  • Diferencial: já ter atuado em CAPS
Additional information

  • Local: Heliópolis - Zona Sul, São Paulo/SP
  • Tipo de Vaga: Efetiva

We are a global digital agency composed of strategists, creatives, media experts, data scientists, and engineers driven by one common purpose — accelerate business growth through marketing and digital transformation. Not only will you be empowered to contribute ideas, but you will also play a key role in the execution and driving success for brands across a variety of industries. Sounds fun? Perfect — you’ll fit right in.

The Data Scientist plays a key role in delivering, maintaining, and evolving our data science solutions for clients. This position blends hands-on analytics, applied machine learning, and software development in a fast-paced, client-facing environment. The primary responsibility is to fit, run, maintain, and configure our suite of data science models and pipelines for clients, while also taking on ad hoc analytical projects and contributing to our shared solution code base when capacity allows.
This is a hybrid role—part data scientist as an analyst, part developer, and part researcher. You’ll work closely with internal teams and some of the world’s leading brands to test, refine, and operationalize models that drive meaningful business outcomes. When not actively engaged in client delivery, you’ll contribute to our internal development efforts by improving productized data science tools, frameworks, and automation capabilities.
The role offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure across the full data science lifecycle—from research and experimentation to deployment, performance monitoring, and ongoing model enhancement. It’s designed for someone eager to deepen both their technical and business acumen, expand their experience across diverse use cases, and prepare for advancement into a Senior Data Scientist position.

What You’ll Do Here:
  • Fit, run, maintain, and contribute to the build of proprietary machine learning models including:
    • Marketing and Media Mix.
    • Performance Forecasting.
    • Price Elasticity.
    • Competitive Pricing.
    • Merchandising Optimization.
    • Audience Segmentation.
    • Lift Studies.
  • Collaborate with Sr. Data Scientists, ML Operations Engineers, and Data engineers to support the build and validation of enterprise data science solutions.
  • Collaborate with marketing and strategy teams to understand client needs and translate them into data science problems.
  • Design and conduct lift studies to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of our solutions.
  • Create insightful visualizations to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in machine learning and data science, and propose innovative solutions to improve our offerings.
We Need a Person With:
  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, with experience using common Data Science libraries such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib.
  • Experience with SQL.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
  • Adaptability and eagerness to learn in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professional and personal integrity.
  • A detail-oriented mindset, focused on driving results.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
What We Consider a Plus:
  • Experience with MLOps and leading machine learning algorithms like XGBoost, Neural Networks, Regression Analysis, etc.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Experience with AWS SageMaker.
  • Experience working in MLOps framework and ability to contribute to the pipeline and collaborate closely with MLOps Engineers.
  • Experience with AI and agentic systems is a plus.
